arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Maine's lawyer said Congress encouraged states to handle youth access.
The association's lawyer said the law relates to carrier service.
Chief Justice Roberts asked if the law dictates carrier actions.
Justice Souter noted the goal was ending state patchwork.
